title: Takeaways from Investor Day 2026: Brookfield Corporation
description:
What’s next for Brookfield? On this episode of Brookfield Perspectives, we bring you highlights from Brookfield Corporation’s 2026 Investor Day, where leaders outline the opportunities shaping the next chapter of growth — from a generational investment cycle in technology, energy and infrastructure to the outlook for real estate, insurance and long-term value creation.


Please read this disclaimer (https://www.brookfield.com/podcast-disclaimer)  (https://www.brookfield.com/podcast-disclaimer) before listening.
